title: Photon Surfaces in Higher-Curvature Gravity: Implications for Quasinormal Modes and Gravitational Lensing
summary: Effective field theory (EFT) provides a systematic framework to describe deviations from general relativity through higher-curvature corrections to the gravitational action. In this work, we investigate test-field quasinormal modes (QNMs) and weak and strong gravitational lensing in static, spherically symmetric spacetimes with higher-curvature corrections, focusing on null geodesics near the photon sphere.
